request.description:
[https://singnify.com/api/v2/php/register.php](https://singnify.com/api/v2/php/register.php). This API endpoint is used to register a new member. It is an HTTP POST request to the `register.php` file located at `{{base_url}}api/v2/php/`.

To register a new member, you need to provide the necessary information in the request body. The response will contain the details of the registered member.

Please Note: is_artist can only be 1 or 0.

The response for this request will have a status code of 200, indicating a successful registration. The response body will contain a JSON object with the following properties:

- `status`: The status of the registration process.
    
- `message`: A message related to the registration process.
    
- `member`: An object containing the details of the registered member. The properties of the `member` object are as follows:
    
    - `ID`: The unique identifier of the member.
        
    - `Username`: The username of the member.
        
    - `EmailAddress`: The email address of the member.
        
    - `Password`: The password of the member.
        
    - `Active`: The activation status of the member.
        
    - `TimeNumber`: The time number of the member.
        
    - `OAuthProvider`: The OAuth provider of the member.
        
    - `OAuthUID`: The OAuth unique identifier of the member.
        
    - `FirstName`: The first name of the member.
        
    - `LastName`: The last name of the member.
        
    - `Picture`: The picture of the member.
        
    - `Gender`: The gender of the member.
        
    - `Locale`: The locale of the member.
        
    - `Created`: The creation date of the member.
        
    - `Modified`: The modification date of the member.
        
    - `Link`: The link of the member.
        
    - `Phone`: The phone number of the member.
        
    - `Country`: The country of the member.
        
    - `Facebook`: The Facebook profile of the member.
        
    - `Twitter`: The Twitter profile of the member.
        
    - `Instagram`: The Instagram profile of the member.
        
    - `YouTube`: The YouTube profile of the member.
        
    - `StageName`: The stage name of the member.
        
    - `Suspension`: The suspension status of the member.
        
    - `Referrer`: The referrer of the member.
        
    - `ReferralAmount`: The referral amount of the member.
        
    - `Membership`: The membership of the member.
        
    - `MembershipDeadline`: The deadline of the membership.
        
    - `ActiveMembership`: The active membership status of the member.
        
    - `IsServiceCharge`: The service charge status of the member.
        
    - `ServiceChargeAmount`: The service charge amount of the member.
        
    - `IsMonthCharge`: The monthly charge status of the member.
        
    - `MonthChargeAmount`: The monthly charge amount of the member.
        
    - `MonthChargePayTime`: The payment time of the monthly charge.
        
    - `MonthChargeExpireTime`: The expiration time of the monthly charge.
        
    - `Contract`: The contract of the member.
        
    - `IsVerified`: The verification status of the member.
        
    - `Signature`: The signature of the member.
        
    - `SignedContract`: The signed contract of the member.
        
    - `LatestNoteID`: The latest note ID of the member.
        
    - `RecordLabel`: The record label of the member.
        
    - `WithdrawnPoints`: The withdrawn points of the member.
        
    - `TotalPointsEarned`: The total points earned by the member.
        
    - `IsPaused`: The pause status of the member.
        
    - `PointRoyalty`: The point royalty of the member.
        
    - `StripeCustomerID`: The Stripe customer ID of the member.
        
    - `About`: The about section of the member.
        
    - `FCMToken`: The FCM token of the member.
        
    - `IsArtist`: The artist status of the member.
        
    - `OTP`: The OTP (One-Time Password) of the member.
        
    - `Token`: The token of the member.
        

Please note that the actual values for the properties will be specific to the registered member and will not be included in the response description.

You can use this API endpoint to add new members to your system.

    - `ID`: The unique identifier of the user.
        
    - `Username`: The username of the user.
        
    - `EmailAddress`: The email address of the user.
        
    - `Password`: The new password for the user.
        
    - `Active`: A flag indicating whether the user's account is active or not.
        
    - `TimeNumber`: A timestamp indicating the time of the password reset.
        
    - `OAuthProvider`: The OAuth provider used for authentication.
        
    - `OAuthUID`: The unique identifier provided by the OAuth provider.
        
    - `FirstName`: The first name of the user.
        
    - `LastName`: The last name of the user.
        
    - `Picture`: The profile picture of the user.
        
    - `Gender`: The gender of the user.
        
    - `Locale`: The locale or language preference of the user.
        
    - `Created`: The timestamp indicating the creation time of the user's account.
        
    - `Modified`: The timestamp indicating the last modification time of the user's account.
        
    - `Link`: A link to the user's profile.
        
    - `Phone`: The phone number of the user.
        
    - `Country`: The country of the user.
        
    - `Facebook`: The Facebook profile URL of the user.
        
    - `Twitter`: The Twitter profile URL of the user.
        
    - `Instagram`: The Instagram profile URL of the user.
        
    - `YouTube`: The YouTube profile URL of the user.
        
    - `StageName`: The stage name or artist name of the user.
        
    - `Suspension`: A flag indicating whether the user's account is suspended or not.
        
    - `Referrer`: The referrer of the user.
        
    - `ReferralAmount`: The referral amount earned by the user.
        
    - `Membership`: The membership status of the user.
        
    - `MembershipDeadline`: The deadline for the user's membership.
        
    - `ActiveMembership`: A flag indicating whether the user has an active membership or not.
        
    - `IsServiceCharge`: A flag indicating whether service charges are applicable for the user or not.
        
    - `ServiceChargeAmount`: The amount of service charges applicable for the user.
        
    - `IsMonthCharge`: A flag indicating whether monthly charges are applicable for the user or not.
        
    - `MonthChargeAmount`: The amount of monthly charges applicable for the user.
        
    - `MonthChargePayTime`: The timestamp indicating the time of monthly charge payment.
        
    - `MonthChargeExpireTime`: The timestamp indicating the expiration time of monthly charges.
        
    - `Contract`: The contract details of the user.
        
    - `IsVerified`: A flag indicating whether the user's account is verified or not.

    - `SignedContract`: A flag indicating whether the user has signed a contract or not.
        
    - `LatestNoteID`: The ID of the latest note associated with the user.
        
    - `RecordLabel`: The record label associated with the user.
        
    - `WithdrawnPoints`: The number of points withdrawn by the user.
        
    - `TotalPointsEarned`: The total number of points earned by the user.

This HTTP POST request is used to discover music platforms and their corresponding music data. The request is sent to the endpoint `{{base_url}}api/v2/php/discover.php`. The response of the last execution had a status code of 200 and contained information about various music platforms and their associated music data.

Get the value of the **type** parameter from the **Show Listing** API endpoint, it is in the **listDiscover** object.

The response body consists of the following properties:

- `status`: The status of the response.
    
- `message`: A message related to the response.
    
- `introductions`: An array of introduction objects, each containing information about an introduction. Each introduction object has the following properties:
    
    - `id`: The ID of the introduction.
        
    - `title`: The title of the introduction.
        
    - `description`: The description of the introduction.
        
    - `url`: The URL associated with the introduction.
        
    - `active`: The active status of the introduction.
        
    - `time_number`: The time number of the introduction.
        
    - `image`: The image associated with the introduction.
        
    - `thumb_image`: The thumbnail image associated with the introduction.
        
    - `middle`: The middle property of the introduction.
        
    - `button_name`: The name of the button associated with the introduction.
        
    - `app_url`: The URL of the app associated with the introduction.
        
- `result`: An object containing music data categorized by different platforms. Each platform is represented as a key in the object, and the value is an array of music data objects. Each music data object has the following properties:
    
    - `f_id`: The ID of the music data.
        
    - `function`: The function associated with the music data.
        
    - `f_table`: The table associated with the music data.
        
    - `active`: The active status of the music data.
        
    - `col`: The column of the music data.
        
    - `f_order`: The order of the music data.
        
    - `f_chart`: The chart associated with the music data.
        
    - `track_name`: The name of the track.
        
    - `label`: The label associated with the track.
        
    - `genre`: The genre of the track.
        
    - `language`: The language of the track.
        
    - `image`: The image associated with the track.
        
    - `audio`: The audio associated with the track.
        
    - `time_number`: The time number of the track.
        
    - `duration`: The duration of the track.
        
    - `country`: The country associated with the track.
        
    - `choice`: The choice of the track.
        
    - `base`: The base property of the track.
        
    - `chart`: The chart associated with the track.
        
    - `user_id`: The ID of the user associated with the track.
        
    - `id`: The ID of the track.
        
    - `music_id`: The ID of the music associated with the track.
        
    - `no_plays`: The number of plays of the track.
        
    - `no_downloads`: The number of downloads of the track.
        
    - `is_ran`: The is_ran property of the track.
        
    - `f_time_number`: The f_time_number property of the track.
        
    - `date_created`: The date of creation of the track.
        
    - `data_id`: The ID of the data associated with the track.
        
    - `actor`: The actor associated with the track.
        

Additionally, there are specific platforms listed as keys in the `result` object, such as "Mixcloud", "Google Music", "Deezer", "Fizy", "Amazon Music", "NextXtar", "All Digital Platforms", "YouTube", "Boomplay", "Shazam", "ITunes", "TIDAL", "Napster", "7 Digital", and "Slacker". Each platform key has an array value containing music data objects specific to that platform.

request.description:
id is the ID of the user uploading the music and it is to be got from the member object

nounce is a unique number that is used to identify the chunk of data for File Appending

no is 1 for track and for an album, it increases per track.  
  
For example an Album with 3 tracks would have:  
no =. 1 (for Track 1)  
no = 2 (for Track 2)  
no = 3 (for Track 3)

file is the name of the MP3 file, make use it includes the file extension.

file_data is the base64 encoded chunk of data for the file to be uploaded.

request.description:
token is from the member object

membership_fee, ref_amount, rate. total_fee, service_is, service_amount, and express_type options are to be gotten from the **Pre Express Music Purchase**.

music_data_id is the DataID in the music object.

base is either track or album

base_id is 0 for track or the ID of the Album track

music_id is the ID of the music

reference is the reference from the payment method, if referral is the selected form of payment, generate a reference.

payment could be:  
Paystack  
Flutterwave International  
Stripe  
PayPal  
Referral

live_date is YYYY-MM-DD

The express_type can either be 0 or 1.  
0 for Express Delivery  
1 for Title for the Premium Express Delivery  
**{{options are provided in the Pre Express Music Purchase API Endpoint}}**

is_webhook is 0

token is the user's Token from member object.

type values are either takedown or promotions

music_id is a string of the ID of the music/track separated by commas. For Example: 23,40,35

plat_id is a string of the key of the platforms in the promotions object of the Listings API endpoint separated by commas. For Example: 1,2,6,0

promotype is the response to the question "Is the track or album to promote distributed by NextXtar?"

promolink is the response to the form input "Enter the link to the Track or Album to promote"

take_arg is set to 0 but you have to set it to one is the user confirms the response gotten when the status of running this API endpoint is 250.

If the status is 250, you get this message  
"If you have 1 more final takedown request without payment. If you proceed with this takedown, your account would be suspended. However, making the payment for the takedown still keeps your account active. Would you like to pay for this takedown?"  
  
If the user says YES, set take_arg to 1 and re-submit the API endpoint to get the total_fee.

token is the user's token from member object

reference is provided by you

// I use this format

var date_stamp = new Date();  
var ref = "G"+date_stamp.getTime()+"K"+Math.floor(Math.random() \* 1000000)+"";

payment value options are: Paystack, Flutterwave International, Stripe, PayPal, Referral

rate comes from show listings API endpoint

ref_amount is the ReferralAmount from Member object

type values are: takedown or promotions

music_id is a string of the ID of the tracks separated with commas. For Example: 40,23,1,45

locations is entered by the user.

is_webhook always set to 0.

promotype is the response to the question "Is the track or album to promote distributed by NextXtar?"

promolink is the response to the form input "Enter the link to the Track or Album to promote"

total_fee, ind_cost, plat_id get it from the response from "Pre Promotions & Takedown Purchase" API Endpoint

The tags and urls are separated by <||::>  
The tags are the ColumnNames of the fanlinks  
You can see the HTML form input structure from the Set Fanlink Form API.

The bank_type values are:  
swift  
localpay  
paypal  
wise

For swift we have:  
ben_name  
iban_number  
account_number  
ben_bank  
swift_code  
bank_account  
intermediary_bank  
currency  
country  
city  
token  
API_KEY

For PayPal we have:  
paypal_email  
token  
API_KEY

For wise we have:  
wise_details  
token  
API_KEY

For localpay we have:  
bank_name  
account_name  
account_number  
country  
token  
API_KEY
